description: Phenol red displays a dramatic pH-dependent chromophore shift: the protonated acid form (HPS-) absorbs at ~433 nm (yellow, epsilon ~8,700 L/mol/cm) via a benzenoid pi->pi* transition, while deprotonation to the quinoid dianion (PS2-) red-shifts absorption to ~558 nm (red/violet, epsilon ~22,000 L/mol/cm) through extended conjugation across the sulfonphthalein chromophore.
clinicalNote: Used as a non-toxic, cell-impermeant pH indicator in cell culture media (turning yellow at acidic pH and red/violet at alkaline pH) and historically as a renal function test agent (PSP test).

sources.purpose: Chemical identity and molecular weight (C19H14O5S, MW 354.4)
